subject: radiology
title: DMSA Cortical Scarring, DTPA Renograms and MAG3 Studies

steps.title: DMSA binds working cortex
steps.tx: **DMSA scan** uses technetium labelled dimercaptosuccinic acid that proximal tubular cells extract and hold, imaging functioning renal cortex hours after injection. Photopenic wedges and contour dents mark cortical scars from reflux nephropathy or infarcts, and split function percentages between kidneys guide surgery. It is the reference standard for cortical scarring in children after urinary infections, outperforming ultrasound which misses a third of established scars.
steps.say: DMSA scan labels a tracer that tubular cells hold, imaging functioning cortex hours after injection. Photopenic wedges mark scars from reflux nephropathy, and split function percentages guide surgery. It is the reference standard for cortical scarring in children after urinary infections.

right.title: DMSA limits
points: Repeat at six months for permanence

steps.title: Acute pyelonephritis versus scar
steps.tx: **Acute pyelonephritis** on DMSA also turns photopenic, single or multiple defects with preserved renal contour and size, indistinguishable from scar during the illness itself. Only a repeat scan after six months separates them: recovered cortex refills, scar stays dented and shrunken. That timing rule stops children being labelled permanently scarred from one febrile infection image, a lifelong insurance and follow up consequence from a single word.

steps.title: DTPA follows filtration
steps.tx: **DTPA renogram** follows technetium diethylenetriamine pentaacetate, filtered at the glomerulus without tubular handling, so its time activity curve measures filtration and drainage together. The curve rises as tracer arrives, peaks, then washes out with a half time under about fifteen minutes in an unobstructed, hydrated kidney. Split function from the uptake slope phase allocates percentages that decide nephrectomy versus reconstruction in borderline kidneys.
steps.say: DTPA renogram follows a tracer filtered at the glomerulus, so its curve measures filtration and drainage together. Washout half time under about fifteen minutes marks an unobstructed hydrated kidney. Split function from the uptake phase decides nephrectomy versus reconstruction in borderline kidneys.

steps.title: Frusemide separates baggy from blocked
steps.tx: **Frusemide challenge** floods the collecting system mid study: a dilated but unobstructed pelvis washes out briskly once urine flow rises, while a truly obstructed pelviureteric junction keeps tracer parked despite the diuretic. Timing the dose before, with or fifteen minutes after tracer follows the F minus, F zero and F plus fifteen protocols centres argue about. A poorly functioning kidney cannot answer frusemide, so non response there is uninterpretable, not obstruction.

steps.title: MAG3 beats DTPA in weak kidneys
steps.tx: **MAG3 renogram** uses tubular secretion rather than filtration, extracting far more tracer per pass, so kidneys with poor filtration, newborn kidneys and transplant kidneys still draw readable curves where DTPA fades into background. It has become the default renogram tracer in most departments for exactly that extraction advantage. Its split function reflects tubular extraction, close enough to filtration shares for surgical decisions in obstructed systems.

steps.title: Captopril renogram hunts stenosis
steps.tx: **Captopril renogram** stresses the kidney with an angiotensin converting enzyme inhibitor: a kidney behind renal artery stenosis depends on angiotensin to hold its filtration, so its curve collapses after captopril while the normal side sails on. A baseline study is compared because one abnormal post captopril curve alone misleads in dehydration and bilateral disease. The test now shares territory with CT and MR angiography, surviving where functional significance of a known narrowing is the question.

steps.title: Transplant kidney curves
steps.tx: **Transplant renogram** reads perfusion and excretion in the iliac fossa graft: acute tubular necrosis keeps perfusion with delayed excretion after ischaemic injury, rejection worsens perfusion itself over days, and a urine leak pools tracer outside every collecting boundary. Cyclosporin toxicity mimics rejection on curves, so the scan triages biopsy timing rather than replacing histology. A rising creatinine with a beautiful renogram points away from graft catastrophe toward drug and volume causes.

A rising creatinine with a beautiful renogram points away from graft catastrophe toward drug causes.

steps.title: Split function decides surgery
steps.tx: **Split renal function** percentages from renogram or DMSA allocate how much work each kidney does, with a share under forty percent called reduced and under ten to fifteen percent often called non salvageable in obstruction decisions. The number is read beside drainage, symptoms, infection and the other kidneys health, never alone. A silent ten percent kidney causing hypertension or infection may still earn nephrectomy, while an asymptomatic one is watched.
